roles.description: Lead a team of 7 engineers on ChatLLM's core agentic infrastructure, serving 400k+ users. Architected a task-classified model router across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini (45% fewer LLM calls per turn), shipped the chat-to-agent hand-off now routing 31k conversations a week, cut input-token spend by ~$1.5M a year through prompt caching, and built the structured tool-use layer and virtual file system behind agent document generation and diff-based code edits.

roles.role: Technical Lead, Health Expert (ChatLLM Health Vertical)
roles.description: Identified health questions as 7.5% of all ChatLLM conversations and launched a mobile-first product that reached 1,000 connected users in two weeks. Built the backend and full iOS and Android clients, reconciling readings across 8 wearable ecosystems into recovery and sleep scores, moved ingestion to webhook-first delivery with an in-house HealthKit pipeline (62% fewer third-party API events), and designed a push notification system whose holdout showed re-engagement pushes more than doubled return visits.

roles.role: Technical Lead, Role Play (ChatLLM Character Chat Vertical)
roles.description: Launched an AI character chat product with a catalog, one-click character creation, voice, and scene illustration; two-thirds of chats are on user-created characters. Built the detector and hand-off that move role-play out of the general assistant onto a dedicated stack, converting 25% of users shown the offer and cutting cost per reply by over 90%.

Built automation workflows using OCR, PDF parsing, and deterministic similarity scoring to generate manufacturer sales quotes from unstructured documents and images. Designed a dogfood data pipeline to measure LLM accuracy on inventory translation against real orders.
